angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 320,022 km at 173.37 pc = 0.02 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.7682 +/- 0.0181 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 173.37 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.46 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Morton et al. 2016, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-732 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2016ApJ...822...86M/abstract): 320,022 km at 695,700 km per solar radius.
